key_insight: In incompressible MHD turbulence, simultaneous cross-helicity transfer constrains triad dynamics enough to uniquely decompose nonlinear energy and cross-helicity transfers into pair exchanges.
engineering_relevance: This result provides a rigorous foundation for diagnosing energy-transfer pathways in incompressible MHD turbulence relevant to conducting-fluid and plasma simulations.
method: Analyze conservative nonlinear exchanges among three interacting spatial fluctuations.
Use simultaneous cross-helicity transfer to constrain the ambiguity in pairwise energy exchanges.
Prove uniqueness of the resulting pair-exchange representation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a mathematical uniqueness proof, with no numerical benchmarks or experimental validation described.
watch_item: The uniqueness result is stated for incompressible MHD and should not be assumed to extend to compressible MHD or Navier–Stokes turbulence.
